environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnets (no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled and the allowed-principals list is restricted to two specific AWS account IDs (the internal platform account and the CI/CD account). The consumer VPC endpoint has a VPC endpoint policy that restricts actions to POST /api/v2/tokens/validate only from IAM roles matching 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/TokenConsumer-*'. The private subnet route table has NO route to 0.0.0.0/0 (no NAT gateway, no IGW). Security group on the NLB target allows inbound only from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). DNS is private hosted zone only — no public DNS resolution exists for the service hostname.

config.network: no IGW route, no NAT, private subnets only
